title: Bound retry loops
why: An unconditional retry loop can consume resources forever and conceal a persistent dependency failure.
suggestion: Add an attempt limit or deadline, backoff, and a terminating failure path.
limitations: Only literal while True and while 1 loops containing try and an except handler that directly continues are reported; passive service loops that swallow an error are excluded.

A direct break, return, or raise in that handler, or a visible attempt, deadline, shutdown, stop, or cancellation guard with a terminating branch, is accepted; bounds hidden behind helper functions are not inferred.
